subject.title: fix(vydra): apply request policy to media generation requests

question: Should OpenClaw treat a generated asset on the exact configured Vydra origin as trusted for provider authorization and configured request headers, while stripping them for every other origin?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent and proof-backed, but this defines the durable credential-forwarding boundary for generated-media URLs.

options.title: Approve exact-origin forwarding
options.body: Merge with authorization and configured headers retained only when the generated URL origin exactly matches the configured Vydra base origin.

options.title: Require stricter asset isolation
options.body: Pause the PR and require generated-media downloads to omit provider headers even for same-origin URLs if the provider trust model should separate API and asset hosts.

recommendation.title: Approve exact-origin forwarding
recommendation.body: Merge with authorization and configured headers retained only when the generated URL origin exactly matches the configured Vydra base origin.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the adjacent Vydra generated-media download and deadline path.
